question: In which state will you find the Mahendragiri Hills?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odisha.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mahendragiri Hills** is located in the** Paralakhemundi region **of Gajapati district in **Odisha.**
 
• Mahendragiri Hills is a part of the **Eastern Ghats mountain range, **and it is also known as the **Mahendra Parvat.**
 
• It is considered to be a sacred place by the locals, and it is believed that **Lord Parashurama,** an incarnation of Lord Vishnu, meditated here.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• At **3,636 meters, Sandakphu **is the highest hill in **West Bengal**.

 
 
• At 3,600 meters, **Phalut,** sometimes known as** Falut,** is the **second-highest peak** in** West Bengal, India.**
 
 
 
• **Jharkhand** is home to several hill ranges, including the **Chota Nagpur Plateau and the Parasnath Hills.**
 
• **Chhattisgarh **has several hills and mountain ranges, including the **Maikal Hills and the Satpura Range**.
